mapper.select: SELECT os.SALE_ORDER_ID, os.USER_ID, os.ORDER_STATUS, os.ORDER_DATE, osi.SALE_ITEM_ID, osi.ORDER_QUANTITY, osi.TOTAL_PRICE, s.TITLE as PRODUCT_TITLE, u.USER_NAME as BUYER_NAME, seller.USER_NAME as SELLER_NAME FROM order_sales os LEFT JOIN order_sales_items osi ON os.SALE_ORDER_ID = osi.SALE_ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN sales s ON osi.SALE_ITEM_ID = s.SALE_ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN users u ON os.USER_ID = u.ID LEFT JOIN users seller ON s.SELLER_ID = seller.ID WHERE os.USER_ID = #{buyerId} ORDER BY os.ORDER_DATE DESC

SELECT os.SALE_ORDER_ID, os.USER_ID, os.ORDER_STATUS, os.ORDER_DATE, osi.SALE_ITEM_ID, osi.ORDER_QUANTITY, osi.TOTAL_PRICE, s.TITLE as PRODUCT_TITLE, u.USER_NAME as BUYER_NAME, seller.USER_NAME as SELLER_NAME FROM order_sales os LEFT JOIN order_sales_items osi ON os.SALE_ORDER_ID = osi.SALE_ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN sales s ON osi.SALE_ITEM_ID = s.SALE_ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN users u ON os.USER_ID = u.ID LEFT JOIN users seller ON s.SELLER_ID = seller.ID WHERE s.SELLER_ID = #{sellerId} ORDER BY os.ORDER_DATE DESC
